description: FTS3 Web Monitoring (fts-monitoring) versions 3.12.0 through 3.13.2 and 3.14.0 have an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the /linkinfo endpoint. This flaw allows remote attackers to perform blind SQL injection via the source_se and dest_se query parameters, potentially exposing stored cloud storage credentials and token provider client secrets.
